reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs (§6 documentation/dispute right and §2.e real-time usage statistics access) run in the Customer's favour and contain no audit, inspection or verification right binding the Client, and no Vendor access to Client systems — consistent with the rationale that the document grants TrueLink no audit right.

Because AUDIT constrains a vendor-favourable right rather than requiring a protective clause, absence of any audit clause is better than the preferred position; classifying as 'missing' and inserting audit machinery would create a Vendor right that does not exist and would harm our party.

The failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is a heuristic artefact of there being no audit clause to match, not evidence of an unlimited audit right; the rationale correctly explains this.
The §8.f anti-spam technical-mechanism note is appropriately flagged as awareness only rather than treated as an audit of Client records or systems.
